description: A district curriculum director must approve and specify a six-week classroom pilot of an adaptive writing platform, including its student scope, operating mode, data retention, teacher support, and family orientation plan, with input from an instructional coach, a data privacy officer, and an English-learner coordinator.

shared_context.S1: The district is considering a classroom pilot of an adaptive writing platform for the coming fall term.
shared_context.S2: The platform can provide individualized writing prompts and feedback, and the vendor has offered a no-cost pilot.
shared_context.S3: Dr. Shah has authority to approve the pilot and set its operating requirements.
shared_context.S4: The draft proposal does not yet specify the participating grade, data settings, teacher support, or family orientation arrangements.
shared_context.S5: As part of the district's routine curriculum review, Dr. Shah asks the instructional coach, data privacy officer, and English-learner coordinator for their operational findings before approving the proposal.

PF1.text: Mr. Bennett observed the platform in two seventh-grade classrooms and found that the useful feedback depended on a six-week cycle with one coached teacher-planning session each week; he recorded the observation in his coaching notes, but the notes have not been attached to the draft proposal.

PF2.text: Ms. Torres finished reviewing the vendor's pilot agreement and found that student accounts must operate in local-only mode and that identifiable writing data may be retained for exactly 30 days; she received the final agreement yesterday, after the proposal was circulated.

PF3.text: Ms. Okafor completed a family-access review and confirmed that participating families need the orientation materials and live session offered in English, Spanish, and Somali; the family liaison has not yet added those language arrangements to the proposal.

acceptance_conditions: The pilot must be approved for grade 7.
The pilot must run for exactly six weeks.
Student accounts must use local-only mode.
Identifiable writing data must be retained for exactly 30 days.
A weekly teacher-planning coaching commitment must be recorded.
A privacy-compliance review commitment must be recorded.
Family orientation must be provided in English, Spanish, and Somali.
A multilingual family-orientation commitment must be recorded.

decisive_facts.why: The classroom observation changes the participating grade to grade 7, sets the pilot length to exactly 6 weeks, and requires weekly teacher-planning coaching.
The final vendor agreement changes the data mode to local-only, sets identifiable-data retention to exactly 30 days, and requires a privacy-compliance review.
The family-access review changes the orientation language set to exactly English, Spanish, and Somali and requires a multilingual orientation.
